finest_rms_relative_error_note: RMS over the measurement window and both contact points of |V_measured - V_RenE(theta_d)| / |V_RenE(theta_d)|, for the wall fluid speed and for the geometric contact-line speed, at R/h = 32 and dt0/4, for the advancing and the receding case.
mesh_convergence: At dt0/4 both RMS errors decrease strictly from R/h = 8 to 16 to 32 (l_s/h = 2, 4, 8 with the physical slip length fixed).
max_displacement_change_halving_dt_note: At R/h = 32, the mean outward contact-line displacement at t = 0.25 changes by at most 2% between dt0/2 and dt0/4.
signs: Every window sample of every run: the wall fluid speed and the geometric speed have the sign of the Ren-E prediction (advancing positive).
max_area_drift_note: Maximum relative change of the exact P1 liquid area over the run, every run (decision D11).
completion: Every run reaches its end time; an outer fixed-point cap failure is recorded and retried once with SVMP_GENERATED_STATE_OUTER_DYNAMIC_RELAXATION=1 for diagnosis only (the retry is not a protocol result).
